pages.text: Traveler's Backpack, OreSpawn style: three backpacks made from boss hides, with every normal feature still there. You carried the fight to them; now they carry your stuff home.$(p)Each one is crafted around a standard backpack. The hide is the upgrade, everything underneath works like a normal pack, and the strap art shows on your back as soon as you wear it.

pages.title: The Collection
pages.text: Left to right: Mobzilla-Hide in black and purple scale plate, Kraken in teal with sucker prints, Girlfriend's in pink with a heart clasp. The suckers don't do anything. They're suckers.
Six Godzilla Scales, two Mobzilla Scale blocks, one standard pack. See $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/mobzilla)Mobzilla$() about sourcing.
Four Kraken Teeth, four Sea Monster Scales, one standard pack. The $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/kraken)Kraken$() contributes reluctantly.
Pink wool, poppies, and two heart boxes of chocolates from her own kitchen. No OreSpawn Delight in the pack? The grid accepts hearts instead.

pages.title: Standard Issue, Boss Grade
pages.text: Everything a Traveler's Backpack does, these do: full inventory, both side fluid tanks, the sleeping bag, tool slots, and you can wear them on your back through Curios or Accessories. Tier upgrades work exactly like they do on a normal pack: bigger storage, bigger tanks, same hide.$(p)Owning any of the three earns Pack Mule Royalty. The pink one also gets a mention in her diary. See $(l:orespawn_integrations:her_side/date_night)Date Night$().
